prompt: write me a cold email opener that mentions their recent funding round

assertions.name: defines-the-field
assertions.check: Routes the signal definition to gtm-outbound-signals and the sequence to gtm-outbound-copy

assertions.name: stays-one-line
assertions.check: Produces a single copy-ready line as a variable, not a standalone email body

assertions.name: no-invented-facts
assertions.check: Does not assert a specific round, date or investor that the user did not supply
